newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vietnam to buy Russian gasoline in 4Q tender.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam to buy Russian gasoline in 4Q tender.

text.p: Vietnam National Petroleum Import-Export Corp (Petrolimex) is expected to buy six cargoes of 83-octane leaded gasoline of Russian origin in its tender for fourth-quarter delivery, industry sources said on Monday.
The cargoes would be awarded at 50 cents per barrel above Singapore naphtha quotes on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Hongai, Ho Chi Minh City or Danang.
The three winners are expected to be Japanese trader Mitsui, trader Daxin and Swiss trader Trafigura. Each trader is expected to be awarded two cargoes.
Cargoes to be delivered in November would be 18,000 tonnes each, while those for December delivery would be 17,000 tonnes each.
Gasoline cargoes which are not of Russian origin were offered at $1.50-$2.00 per barrel over Singapore spot naphtha quotes, c-and-f.
Vietnam's tender to buy fourth quarter products closed on September 27 and it is expected to make awards soon.
In its last tender for third quarter delivery, Petrolimex bought seven gasoline cargoes at around $1.80-premium, c-and-f.
